name: rosetta-word-wrap
code:
use default
use System.Text.StringBuilder

wrapped(text: string, width: int) -> Pipe[string] is
    let line = StringBuilder()

    for word in text.split([' ']) |> filter(word => word.length > 0) do
        if line.length > 0 /\ line.length + 1 + word.length > width then
            yield line.to_string()

            line.clear()
        fi

        if line.length > 0 then
            line.append(' ')
        fi

        line.append(word)
    od

    if line.length > 0 then
        yield line.to_string()
    fi
si

let paragraph =
    "In olden times when wishing still helped one, there lived a king "
    "whose daughters were all beautiful, but the youngest was so beautiful "
    "that the sun itself, which has seen so much, was astonished whenever "
    "it shone in her face."

for width in [40, 62] do
    write_line("wrapped at {width}:")

    wrapped(paragraph, width) |> each(line => write_line(line))

    write_line("")
od
